cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this ARNT shout video about MCP resources.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎觀看這支 AI in C# 影片，主題是 MCP Resources，也就是資源。

cues.en: So, what is resources?
cues.zh: 那麼，資源是什麼呢？

cues.en: Because many people think that MCP is the same as tools.
cues.zh: 很多人以為 MCP 就等同於工具。

cues.en: And I've said that in many other videos, but MCP is the spec that can actually do more than just tools,
cues.zh: 我在其他影片也經常這樣簡化說明，但 MCP 其實是一套規格，能做的不只有工具，

cues.en: because we have this resources concept as well.
cues.zh: 因為還有資源這個概念。

cues.en: And resources has a kind of forgotten history in the system.
cues.zh: 不過資源在這套系統的發展過程中，有點被遺忘了。

cues.en: Originally, it sounded like it was very much a core thing in this, because if you look at the official specification,
cues.zh: 從最初的設計來看，它似乎原本是核心功能之一。因為官方規格中，

cues.en: it says the tools are executable functions that AI applications can invoke
cues.zh: 工具的定義是 AI 應用程式可以呼叫的可執行函式，

cues.en: to perform actions, file operation, API calls, data queries, and so on.
cues.zh: 用來進行動作、檔案操作、API 呼叫、資料查詢等等。

cues.en: That can be both written as it's only action-based, but it's reading a customer's record and action or not.
cues.zh: 這可能被解讀為只處理動作，但讀取一筆客戶紀錄，到底算不算動作呢？

cues.en: Resources, on the other hand, says data sources that provide contextual information to an AI application, file content, database records, API responses.
cues.zh: 資源則定義為提供 AI 應用程式上下文資訊的資料來源，例如檔案內容、資料庫紀錄與 API 回應。

cues.en: So, is that a getCustomer?
cues.zh: 所以 GetCustomer 應該算資源嗎？

cues.en: It's certainly not something where you actually do write something back.
cues.zh: 它肯定不是用來回寫資料的功能。

cues.en: That is very clear that that is tools.
cues.zh: 回寫資料這件事，很明顯屬於工具。

cues.en: But it's a little unclear, should a getCustomer or getAllCustomers be a tool or resource?
cues.zh: 但 GetCustomer 或 GetAllCustomers 究竟該算工具，還是資源，就有點模糊。

cues.en: It was open to interpretation, but then the real world happened
cues.zh: 這保留了解讀空間，但隨著實際使用情境出現，

cues.en: in that almost all clients implemented tools and sort of forgot resources.
cues.zh: 幾乎所有用戶端都先實作工具，某種程度上忽略了資源。

cues.en: Most modern tools nowadays, or clients nowadays, can do both tools and resources.
cues.zh: 現在大多數現代用戶端都能同時處理工具與資源。

cues.en: But in the early days, almost none of them could do resources, but could do tools, because that was the one-size-fits-all, more or less.
cues.zh: 但早期幾乎都只支援工具，不支援資源，因為工具大致可以涵蓋所有用途。

cues.en: You could interpret this as you are allowed to read a customer.
cues.zh: 你可以把它解讀成允許讀取單一客戶，

cues.en: You are allowed to get all the customers and so on.
cues.zh: 也可以取得所有客戶等等。

cues.en: But what also happened was we began to see that we didn't have endless amount of tokens, so I have often seen clients reject certain tools
cues.zh: 不過後來大家也發現，Token 並不是無限的。我經常看過某些用戶端拒絕工具輸出，

cues.en: because they were simply too big.
cues.zh: 因為回傳內容實在太大。

cues.en: They were returning 10,000 customers and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 例如一次回傳一萬個客戶等等。

cues.en: So tools ended up being to the small amount of data
cues.zh: 因此工具最後比較適合處理少量資料，

cues.en: while resources was for the bigger amount of data.
cues.zh: 資源則用於較大量的資料。

cues.en: At least that was how I took it.
cues.zh: 至少我是這樣理解的。

cues.en: So my take is use tools unless your data amount back from the server is huge.
cues.zh: 所以我的做法是：除非伺服器回傳的資料量很大，否則優先使用工具。

cues.en: So again, there is no clear definition, but resources is actually kind of important for some of the more advanced things MCP can do
cues.zh: 如前面所說，目前沒有明確界線，不過資源在 MCP 的某些進階功能中相當重要，

cues.en: that I will cover in future videos.
cues.zh: 這些功能會在後面的影片介紹。

cues.en: So today we are going to learn about resources and then you can judge on your own if you actually want to use them or not.
cues.zh: 今天先認識資源，之後你可以自行判斷是否真的需要使用。

cues.en: Again, if you have small tools with small amount of data, I would say no, and we will see a little why.
cues.zh: 同樣地，如果只是回傳少量資料的小工具，我會說不必使用資源，稍後也會看到原因。

cues.en: But it's good to know that they are there because of more advanced scenarios.
cues.zh: 不過為了處理更進階的情境，還是值得了解它的存在。

cues.en: So I made a sample under my tools calling an MCP on the remote servers.resources here.
cues.zh: 我在 Tools、Calling、MCP 底下，建立了 Remote Servers Resources 範例。

cues.en: So in this, I just do a normal MCP.
cues.zh: 這裡只是建立一般的 MCP 伺服器。

cues.en: We have done this many times using the model context protocol sp.call and we just say add MCP server with HTTP transport,
cues.zh: 這已經示範過很多次：使用 ModelContextProtocol.AspNetCore，呼叫 AddMcpServer、WithHttpTransport，

cues.en: meaning remote with these tools, and then we say also with these resources.
cues.zh: 建立遠端服務，指定這些工具，再另外加入這些資源。

cues.en: You might have seen it with tools from assembly, but you can also point them out.
cues.zh: 你可能看過 WithToolsFromAssembly 的寫法，不過也能直接逐一指定。

cues.en: Build the web application and we expose it as dash MCP.
cues.zh: 接著建立 Web 應用程式，並公開在 /mcp。

cues.en: And tools are like any other.
cues.zh: 工具的寫法和平常一樣。

cues.en: We have a getCustomerTool and we have a getAllCustomerTool.
cues.zh: 這裡有 GetCustomerTool 與 GetAllCustomersTool。

cues.en: So it's all the attributes here that controls that they are turned into MCP tools.
cues.zh: 透過這些屬性，讓它們成為 MCP 工具。

cues.en: So nothing special here and the customer store in this case is just a fixed dataset representing the business logic.
cues.zh: 因此沒有什麼特別的。這裡的 CustomerStore 只是一組固定資料，代表實際的商業邏輯。

cues.en: Customer is nothing special. It's an ID, a name, and an email.
cues.zh: Customer 也很單純，只有 ID、姓名與電子郵件。

cues.en: So of course, if we have this MCP server, we can get some tools.
cues.zh: 所以有了這個 MCP 伺服器，就能取得這些工具。

cues.en: But we also made some resources here.
cues.zh: 但我們也另外建立了一些資源。

cues.en: And resources are kind of the same as tools,
cues.zh: 資源的寫法和工具很相似，

cues.en: but instead of the MCP tools type, we need the MCP resource type and we need an MCP server resource instead.
cues.zh: 只是改用 McpServerResourceType，而不是工具類型屬性，方法上則改用 McpServerResource。

cues.en: And whenever we look at a tool, a tool get a name and a description.
cues.zh: 工具會有名稱與描述。

cues.en: Over here, a resource gets a URI template, a name, and a mean type, meaning we need to give some kind of URL.
cues.zh: 資源則有 URI 範本、名稱，以及 MIME 類型，也就是要提供某種 URI。

cues.en: And it's not like it's a www.google.com or anything.
cues.zh: 它不一定是 www.google.com 這類網址。

cues.en: We just need to give something, colon, slash, slash, something.
cues.zh: 只需要是某個字串，加上冒號、兩個斜線，再接上其他內容。

cues.en: And in here, something can also use identifiers to get names.
cues.zh: 這些內容也可以包含識別參數，指定要取得的項目。

cues.en: So it's a little more like a regular API endpoint, but inside this is not what is being exposed.
cues.zh: 因此看起來有點像一般 API 端點，不過這並不是真正對外公開的 HTTP 路徑。

cues.en: This is the sort of naming of the resource.
cues.zh: 它是資源的一種命名方式。

cues.en: You can also give a description, but behind the scenes, we're just sending back serialized data about the specific customer
cues.zh: 也可以提供描述。至於背後的實作，只是回傳特定客戶的序列化資料，

cues.en: or all customers here.
cues.zh: 或是這裡的所有客戶資料。

cues.en: But we can also send back things like images where we take a logo and put that in together here, make the bytes,
cues.zh: 也可以回傳圖片。例如這裡讀取一個標誌，轉成位元組，

cues.en: and send it back as what is called a blob resource.
cues.zh: 再以所謂 Blob Resource 的形式回傳。

cues.en: So just a little different attribute, but beyond that, there's nothing much to it.
cues.zh: 所以只是換了幾個屬性，除此之外沒有太多不同。

cues.en: It's a little more verbose in what you need to write compared to the tools, and that might also be one of the reasons why Tools 1,
cues.zh: 和工具相比，需要寫的內容稍微多一點。這也可能是工具最後更普及的原因之一，

cues.en: it was a simpler interface.
cues.zh: 因為介面更簡單。

cues.en: But if we run this, and let me start my Insomnia so we can see it.
cues.zh: 接著執行程式，並啟動 Insomnia，實際看看。

cues.en: Right now, it's not showing anything because this doesn't expose anything to the system, but the MCP server is running,
cues.zh: 這裡目前沒有顯示內容，因為沒有另外公開網頁介面，但 MCP 伺服器已經啟動。

cues.en: and if I bring over my system here and connect, we will see that we get two tools and three resources.
cues.zh: 把測試用戶端移過來並連線，可以看到兩個工具與三個資源。

cues.en: In my case, I've put underscore resource here just to see the differences, but we can also in Insomnia here see the different scenarios.
cues.zh: 我在這裡加上 _resource，只是方便分辨。Insomnia 裡也能看到不同類型。

cues.en: They could be called the same if you want to, but that would only confuse an AI.
cues.zh: 如果想要，也可以使用相同名稱，但這只會讓 AI 混淆。

cues.en: And of course, in real life, you wouldn't make both tools and resources.
cues.zh: 當然，實務上通常不會同時用工具與資源公開完全相同的功能。

cues.en: But if we call a getCustomer with 1, 2, 3, we get a customer back.
cues.zh: 如果呼叫 GetCustomer，傳入 123，就會取得一位客戶。

cues.en: If we call getAllCustomers, we get all our customers back.
cues.zh: 呼叫 GetAllCustomers，就會取得全部客戶。

cues.en: If we do the same down here, we'd get all customers resource.
cues.zh: 在下面呼叫 GetAllCustomersResource，結果也類似。

cues.en: It's a slightly different JSON, but we get essentially exactly the same data.
cues.zh: JSON 結構稍微不同，但取得的資料基本上完全相同。

cues.en: If we get a specific customer, we need to give this part of the UI, and we get our customer back, and in case of a logo,
cues.zh: 如果取得特定客戶，需要提供 URI 中這一部分，就能取得客戶。若是標誌，

cues.en: we get a blob storage back that we can then work with.
cues.zh: 則會取得 Blob 資源，之後可以進一步處理。

cues.en: And of course, this is AI using that, so we can set up, for example, in codecs that we want to use this MCP server and begin to prompt.
cues.zh: 當然，實際上會由 AI 使用這些功能。例如在 Codex 中設定使用這個 MCP 伺服器，再開始下提示詞。

cues.en: So we can go in and say, use my MCP to get the logo and show it.
cues.zh: 可以說：使用我的 MCP 取得標誌，並顯示出來。

cues.en: Let's just get that as well.
cues.zh: 也要求它把圖片顯示出來。

cues.en: And so it will show it to us on the screen.
cues.zh: 這樣就會在畫面上顯示。

cues.en: And behind the scenes, we can set breakpoints.
cues.zh: 背後的處理過程，可以透過設定中斷點觀察。

cues.en: I don't know if I was fast enough there.
cues.zh: 不知道我剛剛設得夠不夠快。

cues.en: It is a resource.
cues.zh: 這是一個資源。

cues.en: This is one of the things AI is so built into using MCP tools, but often it forgets to look at the resources.
cues.zh: AI 已經很習慣使用 MCP 工具，但經常忘記查看資源。

cues.en: So that's one of the reasons why you might want to use tools.
cues.zh: 這也是你可能會選擇使用工具的原因之一。

cues.en: But here we get our breakpoint, and we can see it can do it.
cues.zh: 不過這裡已經命中中斷點，可以看到它確實做得到。

cues.en: It needs to go and list the resources first and then use them.
cues.zh: 它需要先列出資源，再使用它們。

cues.en: But this is a good example.
cues.zh: 這正好是個很好的例子。

cues.en: When I did this just prior to starting the recording, it did it perfectly by itself.
cues.zh: 錄影前我剛剛試過，它當時完全不需要額外指示，就自己做對了。

cues.en: But resources are more intensive to work with, and you need more skills and directions in order to get an AI to actually use it.
cues.zh: 不過資源的使用比較費工，可能需要更多提示與引導，才能讓 AI 真正使用。

cues.en: But we can get our image back, which is just a logo of MCP.
cues.zh: 但我們確實能取得圖片，這只是 MCP 的標誌。

cues.en: And we saw we could get the customer.
cues.zh: 前面也看到能取得客戶資料。

cues.en: Get customer 1, 2, 3.
cues.zh: 例如取得客戶 123。

cues.en: And we will again see it will use the tool to do that.
cues.zh: 可以再次看到，它會使用工具完成這件事。

cues.en: But we can say use the resource version.
cues.zh: 不過我們可以要求它使用資源版本。

cues.en: And it can instead use the resource in order to read it and do the same thing.
cues.zh: 它就能改用資源來讀取，完成同樣的工作。

cues.en: So again, as you can see, an AI can do both.
cues.zh: 所以如你所見，AI 兩種方式都能使用。

cues.en: It is more trained on using tools versus resources.
cues.zh: 只是相較資源，它接受過更多使用工具的訓練。

cues.en: So we actually saw that it failed out here because it didn't have it out of the box, but we needed to tell it it was a resource.
cues.zh: 剛才就看到它沒有直接成功，我們必須明確告訴它，那是一個資源。

cues.en: Sometimes that's not needed in certain scenarios.
cues.zh: 某些情境下則不需要這樣提醒。

cues.en: But what we see here is that in my case,
cues.zh: 不過在這個例子中，

cues.en: I would definitely not for any of these scenarios with my five customers use resources.
cues.zh: 只有五位客戶，我肯定不會在這些情境中使用資源。

cues.en: But the reason I talk about this is that I might have a customer list with a thousand customers.
cues.zh: 但之所以介紹這個，是因為客戶清單可能有一千筆資料。

cues.en: Or those customers is not just like we have in our case here, an ID, a name and an email, but something more.
cues.zh: 或是每位客戶不只像這個例子一樣，只有 ID、姓名與電子郵件，還有更多內容。

cues.en: And suddenly we begin to get a huge payload back.
cues.zh: 這時回傳的資料量就可能突然變得非常大。

cues.en: And in such cases, I will go for resources because I know that certain clients will simply truncate what gets back from a tool
cues.zh: 在這種情況下，我會選擇資源，因為我知道某些用戶端會直接截斷工具回傳的內容，

cues.en: and we get an incomplete result.
cues.zh: 導致取得不完整的結果。

cues.en: If it's a resource, it will always read it all, but it is a little more difficult to get it to actually do it as we saw over here.
cues.zh: 如果是資源，就會完整讀取。不過如剛才所見，要讓 AI 實際使用它，會稍微困難一些。

cues.en: But again, had I had a thousand customers, I would definitely never use a tool for that.
cues.zh: 但如果真的有一千位客戶，我肯定不會用工具一次回傳。

cues.en: That would simply be a too big payload here.
cues.zh: 那樣的資料量實在太大。

cues.en: And I would instead go in and use a resource.
cues.zh: 我會改用資源。

cues.en: So now you at least know what resources is.
cues.zh: 現在你至少已經知道資源是什麼。

cues.en: Again, you might sit here thinking, yeah, I'm never going to use this, but I have an upcoming video very soon with something called MCP apps
cues.zh: 你可能覺得，自己應該永遠不會用到，不過我很快會推出一支介紹 MCP Apps 的影片，

cues.en: and that uses resources heavily.
cues.zh: 那項功能大量使用資源。

cues.en: And when you see that, it will perhaps make a bit more sense.
cues.zh: 等你看到那個例子，也許就會更理解它的用途。

cues.en: But I wanted to cover the basics here first so I could reference this video on that more advanced video.
cues.zh: 我想先介紹這些基礎，之後在更進階的影片裡，就可以直接引用這支影片。

cues.en: So with that, thank you. See you on the next one.
cues.zh: 感謝觀看，下一支影片見。
